title: I shipped an ad-free Queens / Star Battle puzzle on iOS, fully AI-assisted
author: oguzhankayan
selftext:
I'm a solo dev and I just released Birdoku for iPhone and iPad. It's a Queens / Star Battle-style logic game: one bird per row, column and region, no diagonal touching, unique solutions, no timers. 200 levels from 4x4 to 10x10, plus dailies.

The game is fully AI-assisted: code, art, music, and text were all made with AI tools under my direction. I designed the rule set, the difficulty curve, and a simple monetization model. There are no ads or subscriptions. The first 20 levels and the daily Easy stay free, and a one-time $3.99 unlocks the rest.

[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/birdoku-bird-logic-puzzle/id6834830537](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/birdoku-bird-logic-puzzle/id6834830537)

Happy to talk about the workflow or the puzzle design.
